poses:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: THREE actual whole-character cels for a short pop-growth sprite animation of a mushroom nest, NOT a storyboard.
Image1 is the exact three-cell512-square layout,1536x512 in total. Keep these three separate512x512 cells, the original camera, whole-body scale and groundline atlocaly447. Image2 is the exact original level2 creature and style reference. Image3 is the final level3 design, for the material/design of the wooden neck collar only.
Draw three new full-object cels, left-to-right:
LEFT / anticipation1: the ORIGINAL small level2 mushroom prepares a springy pop. Its OPEN umbrella cap lowers about12px and widens only slightly to410px. Crown aroundy173, frontcapedgearoundy270. Neck compresses slightly; the ivory cradle and exactly THREE coral eggs keep their original positions, size and original scalloped design. Bottomy447. No machinery yet. Keep all three eggs visible.
MIDDLE / first-grown hold: a more mature OPEN umbrella mushroom. Capwidthabout425px, crownaroundy145, frontcapedgearoundy248. White neck is thicker, ivory cradlewidthabout325px, same exactly THREE coral eggs. A simple short wooden collar with rope bands matching image3 has grown around the white neck, aroundy260-295. The wooden ring is the ONLY new equipment. No brass lever, no side vents, no bellows yet. The lower body is a little fuller than image2 and stays grounded aty447. Original mushroom identity and broad open umbrella remain.
RIGHT / anticipation2: the SAME first-grown mushroom as the middle cell, same wooden ring, eggs, cradle, body scale and ground. Its cap lowers12px and gently flattens, widthabout435px, crownaroundy160, frontedgearoundy265. A small organic neck compression prepares a second pop. The rigid wood ring remains intact. Do not add vents, levers or bellows yet.
The mushroom stays OPEN in all three cels, with a broad low umbrella cap, maroon underside and visible neck/eggs. Match the exact existing hand-painted coral/salmon surface, broad upper-left highlight, warm ivory rounded cradle, dark teal-black contour about3px at512 resolution. Match the reference's line/shading quality, lighting, anatomy, egg count and perspective. No faces, eyes, extra mushrooms or extra eggs. Continuous complete whole-object drawings with clean edges and real transparent alpha. Keep original relative sizes and large blank margin above; do not fit each object to its cell bounds. No ground shadow, text, labels, borders, arrows, effects, debris or detached pieces. These three cels will be used directly in the finished animation.
spore: Create one small actual game VFX texture: a single tiny glowing ivory-gold fungal spore mote, centered on a genuinely transparent square canvas. The mote is a softly painted rounded teardrop seed, warm cream interior with pale gold highlight, subtle coral-peach shaded edge, small soft light halo. One compact particle only, no trail and no cluster. It must remain readable when downsampled to8-14pixels. Material should fit a warm hand-painted fantasy mushroom game sprite with smooth soft shading, no photorealism and no hard black outline. No backdrop, scene, text, border, ground shadow or extra objects. Make a small bright center with clean generated alpha and surrounding transparent padding.
